owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 6) separates configuration of what the system may use from the internal decision of how work is executed. Grants (SO-O-A), the GitHub connection (SO-O-B), the client registry (SO-05-B), the Settings and Connections view (SO-C-C AC04) and the no-secret rules (SO-O-A AC06, SO-09-A AC02) exist. This contract adds the one table that reads them all, the remote computers, the grant levels, and the internal readiness registry (authenticated, reachable, authorised, capable, usable) kept as events in the project store and the daemon's live state, never a store of its own, which the coordinator reads and the user never manages. Client product names stay in docs/CLIENTS.md.

criteria.statement: memev connections lists folders, repositories, providers, tools and remote computers in one table built from the grants (SO-O-A), the GitHub connection (SO-O-B), the client registry (SO-05-B) and the remote computers, each with identity, granted scope, permission level and last verified time; connect, test, inspect and revoke delegate to the existing commands

Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.

title: SO-A-07 Connections and access: one table over the folder grants, the GitHub connection, the client registry and remote computers, least privilege and revocation, and an internal readiness registry that feeds the coordinator and never shows unknown as ready
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-07) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.06 (Connections and access: the provider and tool connections screen and the internal resource readiness registry) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: MEM-145†, SO-05-B†, SO-09-A†, SO-C-A†, SO-C-C†, SO-O-A†, SO-O-B†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 6 (connections and access settings; orchestration stays internal). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Provider-neutral wording enforced: the table and the readiness registry treat every provider the same way, and the existing client registry stays the only place provider names live. (4) Remote computers are read from the device enrolment already on main (src/engine/devices.mjs); the criterion says so instead of naming a new store.
